newsitem.title: USA: Schering's Claritin safe for asthmatics.
newsitem.headline: Schering's Claritin safe for asthmatics.

text.p: Schering-Plough Corp's Schering Laboratories said on Thursday two of its Claritin allergy medications could now be labeled as safe for use in seasonal allergic rhinitis patients with asthma.
The company said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration cleared changes to prescribing information for Claritin-D 12 Hour and Claritin-D 24 Hour extended release tablets.
While there were no previous labeling restrictions, the safety of antihistamine and decongestant combinations had not been firmly established for use in patients with asthma, the company said.
The approved changes were based on results of a six-week, placebo-controlled study of 193 patients with seasonal allergic rhinitis and asthma.
In the studies, Claritin-D improved seasonal allergy symptoms in such patients with no decrease in pulmonary function, the company said.
